prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing, brand-matched feature graphic.
Create ONE finished GOOGLE PLAY FEATURE GRAPHIC for Lucro Caseiro. Exact landscape aspect ratio 1024:500 (2.048:1), preferably render 2048x1000 for clean downsampling to 1024x500. This is a SINGLE coherent horizontal banner, NOT the four-panel screenshot panorama.
Use attached approved campaign ONLY as brand, photographic character and visual style reference. Match its quiet airy warm editorial look and same fictional woman: dark brown hair in loose bun, warm light-medium olive skin, ivory cotton shirt, rich wine linen apron, three-quarter view looking DOWN at her hands while tying a rose ribbon on kraft cookie gift box. Same recognizable face, realistic soft daylight and anatomy. Do not show her looking at camera. Use her waist-up at RIGHT ~42% of banner, head around x75% y28%, hands and gift box around x75% y76%. Keep face, hands and box comfortably inside safe zone. Cream tabletop across bottom. A couple of wrapped cookies are okay, no other props.
LEFT ~50%: clean typography, vertically well balanced. At x8%, y20% small elegant brand text EXACT "Lucro Caseiro" in rose #B65F72. Main headline in dark wine #4A2332, modern friendly bold sans-serif, large and beautifully readable, exact words on THREE lines:
"Mais clareza"
"para o seu"
"negócio."
Under heading at y77%, a compact single text line EXACT "Preço • Catálogo • Finanças" in wine, not tiny. Place a thin lime #DCE86A flat highlight behind ONLY the word "clareza" without obscuring it. No filled button shapes, no call to action.
PALETTE from brand: wine #4A2332, muted rose #B65F72, yellow-lime green #DCE86A, background warm off-white #FAF8F6, soft rose #F5E5E8. Dominant bright warm background with broad very subtle soft pink field lower portion. Fine rose and lime parallel curved lines quietly flow across background behind subjects, continuing approved campaign visual motif. Small round lime seal on front of gift box. Avoid big dark fields; visual weight stays airy and minimal.
SAFE MARGINS: all essential text, face and hands within central 84% width and 80% height; no lettering at edges. Layout fills canvas with background to edges, no border. App brand serves as text only, no invented icon. No device or screenshot required, no unreadable interface thumbnail. No store badge, no ratings, no #1, no download CTA, no promotion, no stars, no glitter, no busy decoration. Brazilian Portuguese accents exactly correct, especially "negócio", "Preço", "Catálogo". Use real photographic material quality matching reference. One finished export-ready banner with perfectly readable editorial hierarchy.
